items.title: File Widerspruch against rehab rejection
items.quote: Gegen den Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Rentenversicherung Musterhessen-Lahn, Rentenweg 8, 35394 Mustergießen.
items.computation: Letter states it was 'Versandt am Samstag, 21.11.2026' and that the Bescheid gilt mit dem vierten Tag nach dem angegebenen Versandtag als bekannt gegeben. Counting 4 days after 21.11.2026 (Sat): 22.11 (Sun, day1), 23.11 (Mon, day2), 24.11 (Tue, day3), 25.11 (Wed, day4) -> deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on 25.11.2026, a normal business day so no §193 BGB shift needed at this step. The one-month Widerspruch period then runs per §§187, 188 BGB: it starts on the day after Bekanntgabe (26.11.2026) and ends on the day of the following month that numerically corresponds to the Bekanntgabe day, i.e. 25.12.2026. However 25.12.2026 (1. Weihnachtstag) is a public holiday in NW, 26.12.2026 (2. Weihnachtstag) is also a holiday and falls on a Saturday, and 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. Per §193 BGB the deadline therefore moves to the next working day, which is Monday 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter states that the decision is deemed delivered on the 'vierten Tag' (4th day) after the dispatch date, which deviates from the standard statutory three-day delivery fiction under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X; verify this is correct for this Rentenversicherungsträger's rules before relying on the computed deadline.

The due date for the Widerspruch depends on a chain of counting and holiday-shift rules (4-day delivery fiction, one-month period, then Christmas holidays/weekend shift); double-check the final date (2026-12-28) and consider filing earlier to be safe.
